_note: The Forgotten Footprints heritage map. Verified positions come from latitude/longitude in data/objects.json (NSSDCA). `approximate` lists objects whose site is documented but whose exact position is not; each is plotted at a documented nearby point and labelled Approximate. Objects in neither list are shown as Unknown and are not plotted. Basemaps are equirectangular (plate carrée), centred on 0° longitude, east-positive.

Moon.viewNote: Near side only, 60° W to 60° E and 40° S to 50° N. All the Moon objects in this archive are on the near side.
Moon.credit: Lunar map: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, CGI Moon Kit (LRO camera colour mosaic)

Mars.credit: Mars map: Viking MDIM 2.1 colorized global mosaic (NASA/USGS), from NASA's Mars Trek

approximate.basis: NASA's catalogue says the reflector was deployed about 5 m north-north-west of the seismometer. It is plotted at the seismometer's recorded position.
The rover's final parking spot is not given in our sources. It is plotted at the Apollo 15 landing site, where the mission took place.
